'''Lector''' was a title that was held by the [[Director/Legends|director]] of the [[Blue Star Centre]], a philosophical center that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. By [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the position was held by the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Amin Galingal]].
